shared_elements: incised/engraved linear marks on a rock face
small-scale repeated sign-like or figural strokes
justification: Both surfaces bear small incised marks cut into a natural rock face, but that is essentially the only correspondence: A shows a dense, ruled, organised field of legible pictorial signs in ordered rows and columns with a larger figural motif above, while B shows only a few sparse, loosely scratched curvilinear strokes with no discernible ordering or repeated sign system. The organisational logic and the manner of depiction (formal, aligned, conventionalised signs versus free scattered lines) are quite different, so no shared iconographic scheme is demonstrable.
